Charaka Samhita, Sutra Sthana 30 (enumeration of the eight branches)

items.name: Kayachikitsa
items.scope: Diagnosis and medical management of systemic disease: fever, digestive, metabolic, respiratory, joint and neurological disorders.

items.name: Shalya Tantra
items.scope: Surgical and para-surgical care: wounds, fistula, haemorrhoids, fractures, Kshara Sutra, Kshara Karma, Agnikarma and Raktamokshana.
items.curriculum: IV BAMS Shalya Tantra; MS Shalya

items.name: Shalakya Tantra
items.english: Eye, ear, nose, throat, head and dental care
items.scope: Disorders above the clavicle (Urdhvajatru): eye, ear, nose, throat, oral cavity and head.
items.curriculum: IV BAMS Shalakya Tantra; MS Shalakya

items.name: Kaumarabhritya
items.scope: Care of newborns and children, wet-nursing and breast milk in classical texts, childhood disorders. Kashyapa Samhita is the principal classical text.

items.name: Agada Tantra
items.scope: Poisons from plants, minerals, animals and bites; antidotes in the classical sense; forensic aspects. Modern emergency care always takes precedence.

items.name: Bhuta Vidya
items.scope: Disorders of mind and behaviour as described classically, including Unmada and Apasmara. The classical framework includes supernatural explanations that are not part of modern psychiatry.
items.curriculum: Manasa Roga within Kayachikitsa; MD Manovigyana evum Manasaroga

items.name: Rasayana
items.scope: Measures to promote healthy ageing, strength and resistance to disease: Rasayana drugs, diet and conduct (Achara Rasayana).

items.name: Vajikarana
items.scope: Sexual health, fertility and vigour in men and women as described classically.
